fact_text: Foreign rebalancing out of PSX blue chips began as net selling of about USD 140 million, with local investors buying the stock being sold.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Bluechip Stocks at Discount Buy Now | Impact of Crude Oil on PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-11)

fact_text: By early September 2024 the foreign rebalancing outflow had fallen to about USD 53 million, which the analyst expected local investors to absorb.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Bluechip Stocks at Discount Buy Now | Impact of Crude Oil on PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-11)

fact_text: The analyst described the rebalancing as price pressure on strong blue chips rather than a weakness in their operations, which he expects to improve in calendar 2025.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Bluechip Stocks at Discount Buy Now | Impact of Crude Oil on PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-11)

fact_text: The analyst said Meezan Bank's earnings capacity could rise and that dividend opportunities could follow from blue-chip operations improving.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Bluechip Stocks at Discount Buy Now | Impact of Crude Oil on PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-11)

fact_text: The analyst said Hub Power's price could fall in the short term during rebalancing, but its operations and earning capacity should improve.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Bluechip Stocks at Discount Buy Now | Impact of Crude Oil on PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-11)

fact_text: The analyst said Engro Fertilizer's price could move lower in the short term, but its operations should improve in the coming calendar year.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Bluechip Stocks at Discount Buy Now | Impact of Crude Oil on PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-11)

fact_text: The analyst said Attock Refinery's price could move lower in the short term, but its operations should improve in the coming calendar year.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Bluechip Stocks at Discount Buy Now | Impact of Crude Oil on PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-11)

fact_text: The Competition Commission approved the sale of Engro Corporation's stake in a Sindh coal mine, reported in media as going to Liberty and Surti, a deal the analyst called old.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Bluechip Stocks at Discount Buy Now | Impact of Crude Oil on PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-11)

fact_text: The analyst said Agro Corporation could benefit from funds from the Engro coal stake sale, which could allow a one-time dividend as it has paid in past years.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Bluechip Stocks at Discount Buy Now | Impact of Crude Oil on PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-11)

fact_text: The analyst said sukuk issuance generates treasury activity that mainly benefits Islamic banks, with Meezan Bank named as a major player in that segment.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Bluechip Stocks at Discount Buy Now | Impact of Crude Oil on PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-11)

fact_text: Media reported that the Ministry of Finance is considering a green sukuk, which the analyst said would be good news for banks.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Bluechip Stocks at Discount Buy Now | Impact of Crude Oil on PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-11)

fact_text: The analyst expected lower global oil prices to narrow Pakistan's current account and trade deficits, but said Arab Light prices fell less than WTI and Brent, limiting the benefit.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Bluechip Stocks at Discount Buy Now | Impact of Crude Oil on PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-11)

fact_text: The analyst said he did not know the status of Pakistan's talks with Saudi Arabia on deferred oil payments, so the benefit to Pakistan remains unclear.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Bluechip Stocks at Discount Buy Now | Impact of Crude Oil on PSX | Pakistan Stock Market Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-09-11)
